The partial sums repeat every 4 terms:

\[
S_1=i,\quad S_2=-1+i,\quad S_3=-1,\quad S_4=0,\quad S_5=i,\dots
\]

So

\[
A=\{0,-1,i,-1+i\}.
\]

Now compute all products \(z_1z_2\) with \(z_1,z_2\in A\):

\[
0,\quad (-1)^2=1,\quad (-1)i=-i,\quad (-1)(-1+i)=1-i,
\]
\[
i^2=-1,\quad i(-1+i)=-1-i,\quad (-1+i)^2=-2i.
\]

Thus the distinct elements of \(B\) are

\[
\{0,1,-i,1-i,-1,-1-i,-2i\}.
\]

So \(|B|=7\).

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
